caption: Drop it in water before you crack it. #KitchenHacks #Eggs

beats.shot: extreme close-up on a tall glass of cold water
beats.does: lowers an egg into the glass; it sinks and lies flat on its side at the bottom
beats.says: Drop your egg in cold water.

beats.does: lowers a second, older egg into another glass; it sinks but stands upright on its tip
beats.says: Standing up means it is getting old.

beats.does: lowers a third egg; it floats to the top
beats.says: If it floats, throw it out.

beats.shot: medium shot on Mara at the counter
beats.does: holds up the floating egg next to the glass
beats.says: Old eggs have a bigger air pocket inside.

beats.shot: close-up on the three glasses side by side
beats.does: points from the flat egg to the floating one
beats.says: Flat is fresh. Floating is done.
